# Lab 22.7: Deploy a Security Posture & Detect Drift

## What We Are Going to Do
Define a posture with an org policy and a detector, deploy it to a project, change a setting by hand, and see the drift finding.

## Steps

1. **See the predefined templates.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc posture-templates list --organization=ORG_ID --location=global \
  --format="table(name,description)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Write your own posture.** Create `posture.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postures/lab-posture
state: ACTIVE
policySets:
- policySetId: lab-policies
  policies:
  - policyId: no-sa-key-creation
    constraint:
      orgPolicyConstraint:
        cannedConstraintId: iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation
        policyRules:
        - enforce: true
  - policyId: public-bucket-acl
    constraint:
      securityHealthAnalyticsModule:
        moduleName: PUBLIC_BUCKET_ACL
        moduleEnablementState: ENABLED</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create the posture.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc postures create organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postures/lab-posture \
  --posture-from-file=posture.yaml
gcloud scc postures describe organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postures/lab-posture \
  --format="value(revisionId)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Deploy it to your project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc posture-deployments create \
  organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postureDeployments/lab-deployment \
  --posture-name=organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postures/lab-posture \
  --posture-revision-id=REVISION_ID \
  --target-resource=projects/PROJECT_NUMBER</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Cause drift.** In **IAM & Admin → Organization policies** for the project, open **Disable service account key creation** and set it to **Not enforced**. Save.

6. **See the drift.** In **Security Command Center → Findings**, filter on posture drift findings. The finding names the posture, the policy and the change. Fix it by setting the policy back, or by updating the posture if the change was intended.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud scc posture-deployments delete \
  organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postureDeployments/lab-deployment --quiet
gcloud scc postures delete organizations/ORG_ID/locations/global/postures/lab-posture --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Posture | Preventive and detective controls in one YAML |
| Deployment | Applied to a project, folder or org |
| Manual change | Raised as a drift finding |
| Tier | Premium or Enterprise |
